description: This file defines a validator class `ConceptClassValidator` used for validating `ConceptClass` objects within the OpenMRS platform. It ensures that the concept class's name is not empty, not duplicated among non-retired concept classes, and that field lengths are valid.

classes.name: ConceptClassValidator
classes.description: A validator class implementing Spring's `Validator` interface to validate `ConceptClass` objects, checking for non-empty names, uniqueness, and correct field lengths.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class being validated is `ConceptClass`.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a `ConceptClass` object, ensuring that it is non-null, has a non-empty name, that the name is unique among non-retired concept classes, and that field lengths are appropriate.
